records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:
Hi Felix,

This confirms the cancellation of your Wrenfield plan. Sorry to see North Group go -- if there's feedback on what didn't work, I'd genuinely like to hear it.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: North Group churned, flagging for the pipeline review

records.subject: Still want to get North Group set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Sometimes the hardest part is just the first project. If you'd like, send me a rough list of what your team's working on and I'll help set it up myself.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: north group still hasn't created a project a week in, flagging for outreach

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Felix,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, North Group!
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Glad to have North Group on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *North Group* just created a workspace on team.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:a6c9c3e1], [email:209fb134]) - no engagement signal at all. Team plan and active subscription imply some intent, so not negligible, but silence through day 6 makes unaided activation in the remaining 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting North Group's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Following up on my welcome note last week. Nothing to read here, just an offer of help: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is the step that makes everything else fall into place. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it yourself.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to sit with you and set up that first project together, and point out anything useful for the rest of the North Group team along the way.

Best,
Priya
